The '''Andulia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Andulian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Razor's Edge" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Andulia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
